name: DeepL API
tagline: Neural machine translation API for text and documents
description: DeepL API provides high-quality neural machine translation for text and documents across many language pairs. Developers authenticate with an API key, call REST endpoints for translate/usage/languages, and choose Free or Pro plans with different hosts and quotas.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key YOUR_API_KEY header (or auth_key form field). Free keys use api-free.deepl.com; Pro keys use api.deepl.com. Self-serve signup.

pricing.free_tier_limits: DeepL API Free: 500,000 characters/month; Free keys must use https://api-free.deepl.com
pricing.paid_plans: DeepL API Pro: pay-as-you-go per character after included usage; enterprise options available — see pricing page

example.request: curl -X POST 'https://api-free.deepl.com/v2/translate' -H 'Authorization: DeepL-Auth-Key YOUR_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"text":["Hello, world!"],"target_lang":"DE"}'

use_cases: translate text between languages via REST
detect source language of input text
check API character usage and quota remaining
list supported source and target languages
